title: Marriage and plans on arriving in Chicago; the Hall brothers
summary: They married three months after meeting; he planned to stay briefly in Chicago, before offers and mentions of Baby and Minor Hall.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah. And a boyfriend of mine that knew her before he knew me, he's the one who bought the ring, you see, on her hand and the marriage license. And we got married. And we got married. In two, three months afterwards. After you met her. After I met her. Three months afterwards. And we've been going ever since. Now when we got here in Chicago, I had decided to stay here in Chicago about nine weeks. And then I thought I would go to New York and stay about nine weeks because her father wanted me to open business. I wanted to go in business. I had taken up arranging and I wanted to arrange. I thought I could arrange. And I was going back to Charleston, South Carolina and opening up business. But after I got here, after all the offers that I got, Baby Hall, he's another drummer probably.
Yes, I knew him. I knew him. He played just not in our country.
He had a brother by the name of Minor Hall.
Kid Ory. He was with Kid Ory in there.
Yeah, I knew both of them.
